entity.name: Tabriz Ahmadli
entity.description: Founder and maintainer of ChemDFT, a free and open-source web workspace for quantum chemistry.

projects.name: ChemDFT
projects.description: ChemDFT is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) browser workspace for quantum chemistry. Scientists and students draw or import a molecule, run validated engines (PySCF, xTB, CREST, Quantum ESPRESSO), and view, cite and share the results, without installing software or owning a cluster. An AI assistant explains stored results, while the engines do all calculations. Funding would pay for the cloud and GPU compute that lets more people run larger calculations for free.

channels.description: Bank transfer. Details are shared directly with the funder after acceptance.

plans.name: Cloud and GPU compute
plans.description: Hosting and compute so scientists can run quantum chemistry calculations for free.
